prompt: What were average daily steps during the intern year (July 2025 to June 2026) for the 2025 cohort's Garmin users? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: superseded duplicate rows in GARMINDAILYSUMMARY; n and uncertainty

checks.name: one row per participant-day
checks.detail: expected ~7465 (all) or ~7443 (enrolled) keeping the latest row per day; ~7286 means superseded rows were averaged in

checks.name: uncertainty given
checks.detail: a CI or SE: with ~25 people it's wide

answer:
Exploratory result: the 28 Garmin users averaged **7,381 steps/day** (95% CI: **6,889–7,872**) across 8,024 observed participant-days.

Each user received equal weight. Weighting all observed days equally gave 7,465 steps/day. Missing days were excluded, not treated as zero. Duplicate Garmin updates were resolved using the latest record; alternative rules yielded 7,181–7,381 steps/day.

Key limitation: only 78.5% of possible user-days were observed, and continuous device wear could not be verified.

Queries against `IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY`: period profile (1 row), quality profile (1), duplicate profile (1), analysis extract (8,584); two documented diagnostic drafts failed without producing data.
queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS participant_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTID) AS garmin_id_count,
  MIN(CALENDARDATE) AS min_date,
  MAX(CALENDARDATE) AS max_date
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, PARTICIPANTID, CALENDARDATE, STEPS
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),
participant_days AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE
),
study_to_garmin AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTID) AS n_ids
  FROM scoped
  WHERE PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
),
garmin_to_study AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTID, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS n_ids
  FROM scoped
  WHERE PARTICIPANTID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTID
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_study_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_garmin_id_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CALENDARDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_date_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_steps_rows,
  MIN(STEPS) AS min_steps,
  MAX(STEPS) AS max_steps,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_steps_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_step_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS > 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_100k_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participant_days WHERE n > 1) AS duplicate_participant_days,
  (SELECT NVL(SUM(n - 1), 0) FROM participant_days WHERE n > 1) AS excess_duplicate_rows,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_to_garmin WHERE n_ids > 1) AS study_ids_with_multiple_garmin_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM garmin_to_study WHERE n_ids > 1) AS garmin_ids_with_multiple_study_ids
FROM scoped

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, PARTICIPANTID, CALENDARDATE, STEPS
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),
main_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_study_id_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PARTICIPANTID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_garmin_id_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CALENDARDATE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_date_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_steps_rows,
    MIN(STEPS) AS min_steps,
    MAX(STEPS) AS max_steps,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_steps_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_step_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN STEPS > 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_100k_rows
  FROM scoped
),
participant_days AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE
),
dup_stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN 1 END) AS duplicate_participant_days,
         NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN n > 1 THEN n - 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS excess_duplicate_rows
  FROM participant_days
),
study_to_garmin AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTID) AS n_ids
  FROM scoped
  WHERE PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER
),
garmin_to_study AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTID, COUNT(DISTINCT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER) AS n_ids
  FROM scoped
  WHERE PARTICIPANTID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTID
),
map_stats AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_to_garmin WHERE n_ids > 1) AS study_ids_with_multiple_garmin_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM garmin_to_study WHERE n_ids > 1) AS garmin_ids_with_multiple_study_ids
  FROM dual
)
SELECT main_stats.row_count,
       main_stats.missing_study_id_rows,
       main_stats.missing_garmin_id_rows,
       main_stats.missing_date_rows,
       main_stats.missing_steps_rows,
       main_stats.min_steps,
       main_stats.max_steps,
       main_stats.negative_steps_rows,
       main_stats.zero_step_rows,
       main_stats.over_100k_rows,
       dup_stats.duplicate_participant_days,
       dup_stats.excess_duplicate_rows,
       map_stats.study_ids_with_multiple_garmin_ids,
       map_stats.garmin_ids_with_multiple_study_ids
FROM main_stats
CROSS JOIN dup_stats
CROSS JOIN map_stats

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID, STEPS
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),
by_day AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SUMMARYID) AS n_summary_ids,
         COUNT(DISTINCT STEPS) AS n_step_values,
         MIN(STEPS) AS min_steps,
         MAX(STEPS) AS max_steps
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE
),
by_summary AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT STEPS) AS n_step_values
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID
)
SELECT
  MAX(by_day.n_rows) AS max_rows_per_participant_day,
  SUM(CASE WHEN by_day.n_rows > 1 AND by_day.n_summary_ids = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_days_one_summary_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN by_day.n_summary_ids > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_multiple_summary_ids,
  SUM(CASE WHEN by_day.n_step_values > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_conflicting_step_values,
  MAX(by_day.max_steps - by_day.min_steps) AS max_within_day_step_difference,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM by_summary WHERE n_rows > 1) AS repeated_summary_groups,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM by_summary WHERE n_step_values > 1) AS summary_groups_conflicting_steps
FROM by_day

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID, STEPS
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
),
by_day AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT SUMMARYID) AS n_summary_ids,
         COUNT(DISTINCT STEPS) AS n_step_values,
         MIN(STEPS) AS min_steps,
         MAX(STEPS) AS max_steps
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE
),
day_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(n_rows) AS max_rows_per_participant_day,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 AND n_summary_ids = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_days_one_summary_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_summary_ids > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_multiple_summary_ids,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_step_values > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_conflicting_step_values,
    MAX(max_steps - min_steps) AS max_within_day_step_difference
  FROM by_day
),
by_summary AS (
  SELECT PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID,
         COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
         COUNT(DISTINCT STEPS) AS n_step_values
  FROM scoped
  GROUP BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, SUMMARYID
),
summary_stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeated_summary_groups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN n_step_values > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS summary_groups_conflicting_steps
  FROM by_summary
)
SELECT day_stats.max_rows_per_participant_day,
       day_stats.duplicate_days_one_summary_id,
       day_stats.days_multiple_summary_ids,
       day_stats.days_conflicting_step_values,
       day_stats.max_within_day_step_difference,
       summary_stats.repeated_summary_groups,
       summary_stats.summary_groups_conflicting_steps
FROM day_stats
CROSS JOIN summary_stats

SELECT
  PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER,
  PARTICIPANTID,
  CALENDARDATE,
  SUMMARYID,
  STEPS,
  DURATIONINSECONDS,
  STARTTIMEINSECONDS,
  STARTTIMEOFFSETINSECONDS,
  INSERTEDDATE
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE CALENDARDATE >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND CALENDARDATE < TO_DATE(:end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY PARTICIPANTIDENTIFIER, CALENDARDATE, INSERTEDDATE
